ITEM 1 | Dark purple-brown oval olives, glossy and smooth-skinned, about 1.5-2 cm long, roughly 10 whole pieces clustered on the left side of the plate, one or two partly overlapping | 45
ITEM 2 | Rectangular slab of baked dish with golden-orange browned top and melted pale cheese-like layer, moist and slightly glossy, about 8 x 5 cm, roughly 1.5 cm thick, sitting in the upper center of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Brown-and-beige rice-like grains with a fine granular texture, loosely clumped, some darker bits mixed in, spread across the right side of the plate, about 9 x 5 cm and 1 cm high | 85
ITEM 4 | Cubes of golden-yellow potato with lightly browned edges and a slightly glossy, moist surface, about 2-3 cm pieces, roughly 4 pieces on the right side next to the rice | 70
ITEM 5 | Pale off-white flaky, fibrous chunk, moist and slightly shiny, about 6 x 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the lower center-left of the plate | 65
ITEM 6 | Pale yellow-cream wedge-shaped slices with smooth, firm surfaces and slightly crumbly edges, about 3-4 cm long, 1 cm thick, stacked in a small pile at the lower center | 35
ITEM 7 | Dark green leafy greens, wilted and glossy, a few small clumps about 2-3 cm across, placed between the potatoes and the rice on the right | 12
ITEM 8 | Small pale yellow cube of firm cheese with a smooth surface, about 1.5 cm across, sitting on top of the baked dish near its center | 8
